🚀 NEW on We ❤️ Open Source 🚀

Public TLS certificate lifetimes are shrinking to 100 days in 2027 and 47 days in 2029. Reliable automation is becoming essential for infrastructure teams.

Darren Davies explores how open protocols like ACME and EST, along with cert-manager and Certbot, can automate renewals. He also covers common failure points, including missed service reloads, excessive DNS permissions, and inadequate monitoring.

https://allthingsopen.org/articles/automate-certificate-renewal-acme-est
